failed_or_abandoned: First rotate() implementation failed on broadcasting (fixed).

First classification allowed extra shell/RFR light: gave eps = 0.53 (wall) and 0.27-0.49 (RFR), the HE-SB regime, not the observed event with its fixed S1 budget; replaced by the strict definition (kept as a cross-check number).

First route bookkeeping (first material entered after the LXe) attributed all silent histories to the side even when they ended in the outer water; replaced by the final-position route; the initial reading that the top PMT array absorbed them was wrong (they crossed the OD).

Ordering B initially transported the photon from the vertex through the TPC (99.9% failed as multiple scatters, leaving ~30 effective histories); replaced by an analytic survival weight and a start at the TPC exit point.
Variants at N = 9000 showed a 1% heavy-weight fluctuation in one variant (skin 8 cm, bottom route); repeated with three seeds (0.86-1.23%), variant statistics raised to 10 000 and MC errors added.
